label: Chromecast with Google TV (4K) streaming dongle
description: Chromecast with Google TV (4K) is an HDMI dongle running Google TV with Chromecast casting, 4K HDR output and a voice remote. It is WiFi-only: 802.11ac on 2.4 and 5 GHz plus Bluetooth 4.2, powered over USB-C; there is no RJ45 on the device and Ethernet only appears if you buy Google's separate Ethernet power adapter, so out of the box it cannot be cabled.
